questions.question: Can you demonstrate hands-on experience with Apple developmental tools such as Shuri, Claude Code, Apple GitHub, Conductor, DevX, or equivalent internal developer tooling? Please provide specific examples or projects.
questions.eval_criteria: Candidate must explicitly mention experience with 2+ Apple developmental tools (e.g., Shuri, Claude Code, Apple GitHub) in their resume, project descriptions, or work history. Examples of usage or contributions must be provided.

questions.question: How have you applied Machine Learning (ML) models for tasks such as anomaly detection or data analysis? Please describe the models used, the data processed, and the outcomes achieved.
questions.eval_criteria: Candidate must describe experience with ML models for anomaly detection or data analysis, including specific models (e.g., supervised/unsupervised learning), datasets, and measurable outcomes (e.g., accuracy, risk reduction).

questions.question: Can you share your experience with Vision Language Models (VLMs) and how you’ve applied them to computer vision use cases? Provide details on the projects or implementations.
questions.eval_criteria: Candidate must explicitly mention experience with VLMs and computer vision applications, including project names, technologies used, and contributions (e.g., model training, deployment, or optimization).

questions.question: How proficient are you with prompt engineering? Provide examples of how you’ve optimized or improved model outputs through prompt design or refinement.
questions.eval_criteria: Candidate must demonstrate experience with prompt engineering, including specific examples of optimizing model outputs, improving accuracy, or reducing bias in responses.

questions.question: Describe your experience with Git, CI/CD tools, and cloud platforms for deployment and version control. Include specific tools and projects where you’ve managed pipelines or deployments.
questions.eval_criteria: Candidate must list Git, CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI), and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure) with specific projects or responsibilities involving version control, deployment, or pipeline management.

questions.question: How familiar are you with Apple operational tools such as Access Manager, Sentry, PagerDuty, and HelpCentral? Can you provide examples of how you’ve used these tools in your workflow?
questions.eval_criteria: Candidate must explicitly mention experience with at least 2 Apple operational tools (e.g., Access Manager, Sentry) and describe their usage in monitoring, debugging, or incident management.

questions.question: Can you share your experience working with Apple internal systems like Radar, Box, Wrike, and Quip? How have these tools supported your workflow or projects?
questions.eval_criteria: Candidate must mention experience with at least 2 Apple internal systems (e.g., Radar, Box) and describe their role in project management, bug tracking, or collaboration.

questions.question: How have you integrated GenAI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude) into applications to deliver AI-powered functionality? Provide details on the APIs, frameworks, or architectures used.
questions.eval_criteria: Candidate must describe integration of GenAI tools into applications, including specific APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic), frameworks (e.g., LangChain), and measurable outcomes (e.g., feature delivery, user impact).

questions.question: Can you explain your experience with querying and analyzing data from SQL databases such as Snowflake or PostgreSQL? Include details on the complexity of queries, data volumes, or insights derived.
questions.eval_criteria: Candidate must demonstrate SQL proficiency with Snowflake or PostgreSQL, including complex queries, data analysis tasks, or insights generated (e.g., anomaly detection, reporting).

questions.question: How do you write and maintain Python scripts for data validation, pipelines, or analysis? Provide examples of scripts or projects where Python was critical to the workflow.
questions.eval_criteria: Candidate must include Python scripts in their resume or describe projects where Python was used for data validation, automation, or analysis, including specific libraries or frameworks (e.g., Pandas, NumPy).

questions.question: How do you collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., Product, QA, Design) to deliver features from concept to completion? Provide examples of successful collaborations or initiatives.
questions.eval_criteria: Candidate must describe cross-functional collaboration, including specific teams worked with, roles played, and outcomes (e.g., feature delivery, resolution of technical challenges).

questions.question: Describe a time when you had to meet stringent deadlines under pressure. How did you ensure the quality and reliability of your work?
questions.eval_criteria: Candidate must provide a specific example of meeting deadlines under pressure, highlighting strategies used to maintain quality (e.g., prioritization, debugging, or iterative testing).

questions.question: How do you approach debugging and performance tuning in your work? Can you share examples of debugging complex issues or optimizing performance?
questions.eval_criteria: Candidate must describe debugging or performance tuning experiences, including tools used (e.g., profiling tools), challenges faced, and solutions implemented.

questions.question: How do you communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders? Provide examples of how you’ve explained complex ideas clearly and effectively.
questions.eval_criteria: Candidate must demonstrate strong written or verbal communication skills with examples of explaining technical concepts to non-technical audiences (e.g., product managers, designers).

questions.question: Have you worked with Node.js for any AI-related or application development projects? If so, describe your experience and contributions.
questions.eval_criteria: Candidate must mention Node.js experience in their resume or describe projects where Node.js was used for AI integration, backend development, or application functionality.

questions.question: Can you share your experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques or Vector Databases? How have you applied them in your work?
questions.eval_criteria: Candidate must describe experience with RAG or Vector Databases, including projects, tools used (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate), and contributions to AI functionality.
